name: FOG_ALERT
description: Node-to-node broadcast over ESP-NOW (demo) or LoRa (field) when a node detects fog. Packed, little-endian.

fields.name: magic
fields.desc: Always 0xAE (174). Lets receivers ignore foreign packets.

fields.name: flags
fields.desc: bit 0 = clock synced, bit 1 = detected by the virtual sensor, other bits 0.
